scope: Reviewed OMAI formula endpoints and exact Lean source bytes. These hashes detect drift; they are not an automatic symbolic translation or numerical implementation proof.
interpretations: Heterogeneous finite spectrum with full Nat occupations, unweighted eigenvalue sum, product counting measure, dof=0 and phase-space unit=1. The empty-index case has one zero-energy state and unit partition, not a zero-frequency oscillator.

Partition factorization, finite Boltzmann measure and normalized energy integrability are proved. Joint F/U/S/C equal the corresponding mode sums at positive absolute temperature; only finite closed-form sums are differentiated.

Explicit measurable occupation reindexing preserves the rectangular N_q by 3*N_atoms product measure and Hamiltonian. The molar factor N_A/N_q multiplies thermodynamic quantities after ensemble evaluation, never its energies.

Exact upstream hbar/kB, positive-frequency oscillators and fixed uniform q grid. Primitive-cell molar basis, not per atom. Zero/imaginary modes, nonuniform q, thermodynamic limits and producer/numerical correctness remain outside scope.
